actual advice on how to glow the hell up
(no bs, actual good advice, save them)

drink water before coffee.

boring. works every single time.

learn to say no without explaining.

« i can't, but thank you » is a full sentence.

walk everywhere you can.

your mood, your skin, your head.
all of it gets better.

read before bed, not your phone.

you'll sleep better
and actually remember things.

have something to talk about.

before, i never knew what to say at dinners.
now i learn one new thing every morning. and i always have a story to share.
